structural_change: HC quarter engine (plan (b) d4g, HBM-B-RTL2b): 3x3 ring of 8 bank tiles around the hub (hc_<q> + centre, coordinator 10-17 23:45: no empty middle). Chain clockwise from W: b0 W, b1 NW, b2 N, b3 NE, b4 E, b5 SE, b6 S, b7 SW; masters by pin plan (R0 / R180 only): e2 = b2 / b6, e0 = b4, b0 = b0, ca = b1 / b5, cb = b3 / b7. Inside: 8 closed lane leaves hc_lanes_ref (2 cols x 4 rows, 43.2 lattice), the 8 weight macros as ONE abutted N-S stack W of the leaves (pins E, facing them; macro g beside leaf row g//2), the 4 x macros E of the leaves at their rows. e2: chain in W / out E; hub on S carries its own beat slice + write control and both corner feeds. HCRING 10-19 (HH-9 flag, R0->R180 joints): route.pin_balance gives every face a defined bit order (PPL chunks of 32 scattered the buses); faces that abut an R180 neighbour are the mirror image of that neighbour's shared face (range 734.4 - x, high bit first: pin_order_desc).
